latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of multi-search-engine skill version 1.0.0.
- Integrates 17 search engines (8 Chinese, 9 international) with advanced features and privacy options.
- Supports advanced search operators, site-specific queries, filetype filters, time filters, and DuckDuckGo bangs.
- Enables WolframAlpha knowledge queries.
- No API keys required for usage.
